result:
All 617 tests pass, and the build type-checks cleanly. The implementation is complete:

1. **`src/schemas/project.ts`** — added `cloneProjectSchema` and `CloneProjectInput`.
2. **`src/server/services/project-service.ts`** — added `cloneProject`, gated like a creation (read on source + create on org, project quota, then the per-project issue quota checked as one batch before any write), copies description/visibility/color/lead from the source, resets dates/status, and updates search index and usage counters directly (since no `project.created`/`issue.created` events fire).
3. **`src/server/repositories/issue-repository.ts`** — added `copyLiveIssuesForClone`, which copies only live issues, renumbers from 1 in source order, resets status/assignee/timestamps/author, carries labels, and skips comments/attachments/parent links.
4. **`src/types/event.ts`** — added the `project.cloned` domain event.
5. **`src/schemas/activity.ts`**, **`src/types/activity.ts`**, **`src/components/domain/activity/activity-labels.ts`**, **`src/server/services/activity-service.ts`** — added the `project.cloned` audit action everywhere it needs to be accepted/labeled, with the listener recording `sourceProjectId`/`issuesCopied` metadata under the new project.

No existing behavior (create/update/archive) was changed, and no visible tests needed modification.
